provider_policy.scope: Queued subject-model research from WM-XCT-013 onward

waived_providers.reason: The repository owner explicitly instructed the research queue to continue without Grok after repeated structured-output failures.

provider_policy.review_rule: Claude-only results require a separate no-tools adversarial audit and remain reviewable drafts with a visible single-provider hold.

Which authoritative identifier designates the risk entity that this assessment context is bound to?
Which exact revision or version of the referenced risk statement was assessed?
How is this assessment context marked once the pinned risk revision is superseded upstream?
Does the bound subject represent a threat, an opportunity, or both, and where is that reading declared?
Which objectives does this assessment measure the effect of uncertainty against?
Which assets, processes or organizational units are inside the assessed exposure?
Which contextual conditions were treated as fixed rather than assessed for this estimate?
Where anchors are jurisdiction-specific or site-specific, how is the applicable location recorded?
Which risk source or threat source does this estimate attribute the event to?
Which single event or event class does the likelihood dimension quantify?
Which consequences are inside the impact estimate and which named consequences are excluded?
Which vulnerability or predisposing condition is assumed present for the event to occur?
Which external threat or hazard catalogue entry is cited, and under which catalogue version?
Which taxonomy scheme and version supplies the category values asserted here?
Which category values are asserted, and is more than one concurrent categorization permitted?
How is a category value mapped when the adopting Dimension and an external framework use different schemes?
Who is authorized to change a pinned category value after an estimate has been recorded against it?
What is the declared boundary of this assessment and what is explicitly excluded from it?
Over what time horizon is the likelihood or frequency dimension expressed?
What are the as-of time of the assessed state and the time the estimate was recorded, and do they differ?
Until when is this assessment treated as current, and what triggers an out-of-date state?
Which decision or reporting purpose was this assessment produced for?
Which risk criteria set, at which version, defines the scales and thresholds used here?
Which assessment technique or method was applied, and where is its normative definition held?
Is the expression qualitative, ordinal, semi-quantitative, quantitative, probabilistic or scenario-based?
What must match before two records assessed under different pins may be compared?
Who approved the criteria set for use in this assessment context?
In what form is likelihood expressed and against which scale or unit?
Does this record separate likelihood of event occurrence from likelihood of adverse consequence?
If a range or distribution is used, which parameters, bounds and confidence level are stored?
Which operations on the likelihood value are prohibited by its scale type?
Which impact dimensions are scored, and on which scale is each one expressed?
How are multiple impact dimensions combined, or is combination explicitly withheld?
Are safety, health, environmental or fundamental-rights harms represented as first-class dimensions rather than monetized proxies?
Which affected parties bear each recorded consequence?
How are secondary or downstream consequences distinguished from primary consequences?
What definition of inherent or gross risk was used, and which control effects were excluded from it?
What is the recorded inherent level, and how does it relate the likelihood and impact dimensions?
Was an inherent estimate produced at all, and if not, on what documented ground was it omitted?
What derivation or evidence supports the inherent value?
Which explicit assumptions must hold for this estimate to remain valid?
Which information sources and datasets were used, and how current were they at the as-of time?
Was the estimate elicited from expert judgement, derived from historical data, or produced by a model run?
What confidence or data-quality grade is attached to this estimate, and on which scale?
What precision may downstream consumers infer from the stored notation, and which aspects are effectively unmeasurable?
Which controls were relied on when producing the residual estimate, and by which reference?
Which effectiveness determination is cited for each relied-on control, and who produced it?
Which dimension changed between the inherent and residual estimates - likelihood, consequence, or both?
How is the residual value marked as an adjusted rather than an initial characterization?
What is recorded when a control is referenced but no effectiveness determination exists for it?
Which appetite or tolerance statement, at which version, was the residual estimate compared against?
What is the recorded comparison outcome and on which scale is it expressed?
Who recorded the comparison, and which decision record shows the residual position being accepted?
What is recorded when no applicable tolerance statement exists for the pinned criteria?
Which downstream consumers may read the comparison outcome without access to the underlying estimates?
Under what conditions may two assessment contexts be placed on the same scale?
Which caveats must travel with any aggregate produced from these records?
How is scenario dependence recorded when one risk is assessed under several scenarios?
Which scenario or variant is designated the reference case for reporting, and by which role?
How are records assessed under a superseded criteria version handled in a current roll-up?
Which single authoritative catalogue entry does this assertion set bind to, and under which identifier scheme?
Which catalogue release or revision was in force when the binding was made, and how is that pin preserved?
Which control statement parts or enhancements are in scope for this binding, and which parameter values were selected?
What tailoring or deviation from the catalogue baseline does this binding assert, and on whose authority?
How can a consumer resolve this binding without importing the catalogue text into local storage?
What control objective is the control claimed to achieve for this specific host subject?
Is the control preventive, detective or corrective, and which vocabulary and source supply that value?
Is the control executed manually, automatically or as a hybrid, and which part is automated?
Does the control operate at entity level or at process and transaction level for this subject?
Has the control been designated key or non-key for this subject, and who made that determination?
Does this control apply to the host subject, and on what documented basis was that determined?
What population, boundary or component set does the control cover within the subject?
If the control is declared not applicable or only partially applicable, what justification and approval support that?
From when until when does this applicability determination hold?
Which obligation or authority makes this control mandatory rather than discretionary for the subject?
Which party is accountable for the control's continued operation for this subject?
Who is authorised to approve the effectiveness conclusion, and are they independent of the operator?
How is responsibility divided between the subject owner, a shared service and any external provider?
What competence and authority are asserted for the party performing the control?
Which parties may read or amend this control assertion set, and under which role?
Which risk statement does this control link to, and in which direction does the treatment claim run?
By what mechanism is the control claimed to treat the risk: likelihood, impact, detection latency or transfer support?
What magnitude of reduction is claimed, on what scale, and is the claim estimated or demonstrated?
Who asserted this linkage, from which analysis, and at what event and observation times?
What causes this linkage to be superseded or retired, and how is the prior link preserved?
Which controls together are claimed to cover a given risk, and can any one of them cover it alone?
At what level of precision does the control set operate relative to the risk it is claimed to cover?
Which other controls must operate for this control to be effective, and what happens when they fail?
Which linked risks currently have no operating control, and which controls have no linked risk?
How is the coverage set expressed so a consumer can traverse it without loading the full catalogue?
To which entries in other frameworks is this control mapped, and with what relation strength?
Who authored each mapping, against which target framework version, and when?
What does this mapping explicitly not assert about conformance, implementation or effectiveness?
How is a mapping revalidated when either the source or the target framework version changes?
What is the current design status of the control for this subject, and what does that value deliberately exclude?
If operated exactly as prescribed, which part of the objective would the control achieve and which part would it not?
At what threshold, tolerance or level of precision is the control designed to act?
Who determined that the design is adequate, on what date, and against which criteria?
What known design limitation or design deficiency is recorded, and which external record tracks it?
What implementation status is recorded for the subject, and what scope does a partial status actually cover?
Which approved exception or waiver permits a gap in implementation, who approved it, and when does it expire?
Which compensating or alternative control is relied on, and against which defined requirement?
What documented technical or business constraint justifies the compensating or alternative approach?
Which change to the subject last altered the implementation state, and when was that change recorded?
Is the control currently operating, and how does that value differ from being implemented?
At what frequency, or on which event triggers, is the control expected to operate?
How many occurrences were expected and how many observed in the stated period?
Which system or party executes the control, and where is that execution recorded?
What suspends or resumes operation of the control, and how is a dormant period represented?
Which evidence objects support the assertion, and how is each referenced and integrity-bound?
Which assessment methods were applied, and at what depth and coverage?
When was the assessment performed, and which period of control operation does its conclusion cover?
Why is the bound evidence sufficient given the risk associated with this control?
If testing was performed at an interim date, what supports extending the conclusion to the end of the period?
What effectiveness conclusion was reached, on which named vocabulary, and over what scope?
Which assessment and evidence bindings form the sole permitted basis for this conclusion?
What confidence is attached to the conclusion, and what limits that confidence?
Until when is the conclusion valid, and which events invalidate it before that time?
If the conclusion is adverse, what deficiency severity is recorded and which external record tracks remediation?
What change from the inherent to the residual position is attributed to this control, and on which scale?
Which effectiveness conclusion and which attribution method produced the attributed change?
Which residual risk record does this contribution feed, and has the risk model accepted the attribution?
What prevents an untested or ineffective control from reducing the recorded residual position?
When the supporting conclusion expires, what happens to this residual contribution?
Which party holds accountability for the residual risk conclusion on this host record, and which party holds accountability for each linked control?
How is operational execution delegated to another party without transferring accountability for the binding?
Which governance line does each named party occupy for this binding, and does any party occupy more than one line?
What becomes of the binding when the accountable owner role is vacant, reassigned, or the owning organisational unit is dissolved?
Which authority level is required to accept a residual risk in each severity band, and in which versioned threshold table is that requirement defined?
What distinguishes authority to assert a control linkage from authority to accept the residual risk that remains after it?
Which preconditions must be satisfied before a change to an already accepted binding is admissible?
How is an acceptance made under a superseded threshold table detected and re-validated?
Which combinations of asserting, reviewing, approving and accepting the same binding are declared incompatible for one actor?
What establishes that the reviewer of a binding is independent of the party that designed or operates the linked control?
Under what documented circumstances may a duty-separation constraint be overridden, and who may grant that override?
How are duty-separation breaches detected after the fact when they were not blocked at write time?
Which versioned criteria, scale and risk-appetite statement were used to derive this residual risk conclusion?
When two applicable frameworks assign different acceptability verdicts to the same binding, which verdict prevails and on what recorded basis?
What makes the chosen criteria suitable, and how are relevance, completeness, reliability and neutrality demonstrated?
How does a change to the criteria or scale version affect conclusions already recorded under the previous version?
What level of assurance does this effectiveness conclusion carry, and what procedures produced it?
Which parts of the control population, period or environment were excluded from the assessment scope?
Which assessment methods and objects were applied, and what did each method actually examine?
When effectiveness is inherited from a third-party report, what carve-outs and complementary user-entity controls limit reliance?
Which lifecycle states may a risk-control binding occupy on its host record, and which transitions between them are permitted?
How does the host record's own lifecycle constrain or terminate the state of the binding?
Which states are terminal, and which obligations survive after a binding leaves the active state?
May more than one active binding exist between the same risk and the same control on one host, and how is that resolved?
For how long is this residual risk conclusion valid, and what fixes the end of its validity window?
Which events force reassessment of this binding before its scheduled expiry?
What status does a binding carry once its assessment has expired but has not yet been reassessed?
Which timestamp starts the currency clock: the observed condition, the assessor's conclusion, or the recording of the assertion?
Does a corrected assertion keep the binding identifier and gain a new revision, or does it receive a new identifier that supersedes the prior one?
What must a supersession record state about the defect corrected and the period during which the superseded assertion was relied upon?
Which downstream consumers must be notified when an accepted binding is superseded, and within what interval?
Which fields may never be edited in place, forcing correction by supersession instead?
Which agent asserted this binding, on whose behalf did that agent act, and was the agent human, organisational or automated?
Which assessment activity generated this conclusion, and which inputs did that activity use?
From which prior assertion or external report was this conclusion derived, and what changed relative to it?
How is an automated or model-generated assertion distinguished from a human-attested one for reliance purposes?
How is each item of supporting evidence bound to the assertion so that later substitution is detectable?
Which evidence attributes become immutable once the assertion is approved, and what follows if the evidence store mutates them?
How is an assertion treated when referenced evidence becomes unavailable, unreadable or is lawfully destroyed?
What makes the referenced evidence sufficient and appropriate for the asserted assurance level?
Which sensitivity label applies to this binding, and does the label differ between the risk statement, the control description and the evidence?
Which individual fields must be withheld, generalised or hashed when this record is disclosed to a less-privileged audience?
Which audiences may receive which disclosure profile, and who authorises a release outside the profile?
How is it verified that a redacted export cannot be re-identified by combining it with previously released exports?
To which external assessment or risk exchange schema is this binding mapped, and which of its fields have no equivalent there?
Which regional or sector profile is in force for this binding, and over what effective period?
Which profile requirements are formally excepted for this binding, by whom, until when, and with what compensating condition?
When a regional profile and a sector profile impose contradictory obligations on the same field, which one governs?
Which retention schedule and disposition authority govern this binding's records, and when does the retention clock start?
How is a legal hold applied to a binding, who may apply and release it, and what does the hold suspend?
What minimum information survives in a tombstone after disposition, and what must be irreversibly removed?
Which model or policy owner actually executes destruction, and how does this mixin record that the execution occurred?

requirements: Run a separate no-tools adversarial audit of the active provider result.
Verify the model boundary and entry kind against the frozen relationship contract.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Expose the owner-authorized provider waiver in every publication artifact.
Keep the result reviewable-draft while independent second-provider review is waived.
